TRANSFER.SAME_EDUCATOR: The educator the classes are moving from and the receiving educator cannot be the same.
TRANSFER.SOURCE_INACTIVE: The educator the classes are moving from is not active.
TRANSFER.TARGET_INACTIVE: The receiving educator is not active.
TRANSFER.GOOGLE_ADD_TARGET_TO_COURSE: This class is linked to Google Classroom. Add {targetName} to the Google Classroom course first so roster sync and grade passback keep working.

REASON.CLASS_INACTIVE: This class is inactive and cannot be transferred.
REASON.CLASS_ARCHIVED: This class is archived and cannot be transferred.
REASON.CLASS_NOT_OWNED_BY_SOURCE: This class no longer belongs to the educator it is moving from.
REASON.TARGET_NOT_IN_CLASS_SCHOOL: The receiving educator is not assigned to this class's school.
REASON.TARGET_NO_GOOGLE_CONNECTION: This class is linked to Google Classroom and {targetName} has not connected Google for this school. Connect Google and add {targetName} to the Google Classroom course first.
REASON.TRANSFER_FAILED: This class could not be transferred. Please try again.
REASON.NOT_PROCESSED: This class was not processed because the request ran out of time. Please retry.
